recent.text: I’ve always been a Nance fan — would love to see him get a shot at some PF mins right now. Bucks’ execution in half court is generally really poor, so a guy who knows how to run DHOs, makes the right pass, and knocks down threes feels like an obvious positive. Can’t get worse…
recent.author: Frank Madden
recent.quoted_text: @fmaddenNBA Best way to do this effectively is for Sims to get more minutes! He is the only big who sets screens (besides Nance, who is the g league)

recent.text: Would love to see more DHOs and solid screens to give Brayden runway to attack like this. He’s shooting 62% on twos (meaning he should shoot more) and has looked really comfortable pulling up or getting to rim since Vegas.

recent.text: Agreed, lots to criticize Horst for but 2nd rounders are a crapshoot both in terms of talent and timing. Rare to get legit rotation guys like Mamu and Merrill late in 2nd, but developing them (esp on vet team with expectations) isn’t easy. Sometimes it takes a few stops (Rollins)
recent.author: Frank Madden
recent.quoted_text: Bucks fans who use Sandro as a reason to shit on Horst. Not a fan of that criticism. He's on his 3rd team post Bucks with another g league stint in between. I'm ok with some Horst criticism. But this ain't one of em. Glad he's found his footing as a decent role player.
